lines.en: label secondbeach3:
scene secondbeachthree1
: Oh, good. You’re here.
lines.zh: ：哦，好。你来了。

lines.en: : I was beginning to think you’d heard about my itinerary from someone else and were just avoiding me because you are immune to any form of actual planning.
lines.zh: ：我还开始以为你是从别人那儿听说了我这份行程表，然后故意躲着我——毕竟你对任何形式的正经规划都免疫。

lines.en: : Quite the opposite, actually. As soon as Uta told me about your schedule, I basically ran the whole way over here.
lines.zh: ：恰恰相反。Uta 一跟我说你的日程，我基本上一路跑过来的。

lines.en: : Don’t lie to me, you incorrigible bastard. You hate schedules and you know it.
lines.zh: ：别骗我了，你这个死不悔改的混蛋。你讨厌日程，你自己清楚。

lines.en: : I do know it...but was the insult really necessary?
lines.zh: ：我确实清楚……不过那句辱骂真的有必要吗？

lines.en: : Apologies. I didn’t get much sleep last night and am currently running on an unconfirmed amount of espresso shots.
lines.zh: ：抱歉。我昨晚没怎么睡，现在全靠一个数量不明的浓缩咖啡撑着。

lines.en: : I counted fourteen!
lines.zh: ：我数了，十四杯！

lines.en: : You are far too competent for someone running on fourteen shots of espresso.
lines.zh: ：靠十四杯浓缩撑着的人，能这么能干也太离谱了。

lines.en: : I’m sure that will all crash and burn momentarily.
lines.zh: ：我敢说这些状态马上就会崩盘。

lines.en: : But there are several issues at hand here.
lines.zh: ：不过眼下有几件事要处理。

lines.en: : First and foremost, welcome back to the beach.
lines.zh: ：首先，欢迎回到海滩。

lines.en: : Given that our last trip was such a success, we’ve decided to make it an ongoing tradition for all twenty of us even after we’re inevitably placed into separate classes next year.
lines.zh: ：鉴于上次旅行大获成功，我们决定把它变成我们二十个人的长期传统，哪怕明年我们不可避免地会被分到不同的班级。

lines.en: : Yeah, we’ll see about that.
lines.zh: ：嗯，这个嘛，走着瞧。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree2
: Oh, are you intending to switch grades? I hadn’t heard of that plan yet.
lines.zh: ：哦，你打算换年级？我还没听说过这个计划。

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: ：没有。

lines.en: : But...then-
: Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: ：别担心这个。

lines.en: : Well...in any case, the second thing I want to say before things get underway is-
lines.zh: ：嗯……总之，在活动开始之前我想说的第二件事是——

lines.en: : Wait a second, Makoto.
lines.zh: ：等一下，Makoto。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree3
: Ugh. What now?
lines.zh: ：呃。又怎么了？

lines.en: : Now I want to know why Noriko has been just standing here since I showed up and letting you do all the talking.
lines.zh: ：我想知道，为什么从我来开始 Noriko 就一直站在这儿，把所有的话都让给你说。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t mind me. I’m just thinking about how one day, years and years after we’re married, we’ll come back here with all three of our little Nakayarakawayama babies and reminisce about the old days.
lines.zh: ：哦，别管我。我只是在想，等我们结婚很多很多年以后，有一天我们会带着我们三个 Nakayarakawayama 家的小宝宝回到这里，一起回忆往昔。

lines.en: : Thank you for keeping the amount of children to a reasonable level, but I will now return to focusing on Makoto as she has no intention of harboring my children.
lines.zh: ：谢谢你把孩子的数量控制在合理范围，不过我现在要把注意力转回 Makoto 身上，因为她可没打算替我怀孩子。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be so sure of that, Sensei!
lines.zh: ：这可不好说哦，Sensei！

lines.en: : Makoto’s growin’ at a rapid rate and sooner or later those hips of hers will be perfect for poppin’ out a few four eyed babies of her own!
lines.zh: ：Makoto 正以飞快的速度发育着，迟早她那副胯骨会变得特别适合往外蹦几个四眼小宝宝！

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree4
: Thank you very much, Miku. I’m sure that was a thing everyone was interested in hearing.
lines.zh: ：非常感谢，Miku。我相信大家都很想听这个。

lines.en: : Now, may I please-
lines.zh: ：那么，我能不能——

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree5
: Nope! Cause now it’s my turn to talk to Sensei about beach stuff!
lines.zh: ：不行！因为现在轮到我跟 Sensei 聊海滩的事了！

lines.en: : Didn’t you literally walk here with him? That should have been more than a sufficient amount of time to talk.
lines.zh: ：你不是刚刚才跟他一起走过来的吗？那时间应该够你聊的了。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree6
: Makoto, Makoto, Makoto. You should know more than anyone that there can be no sufficient amount of time with Sensei.
lines.zh: ：Makoto 啊 Makoto，Makoto。你应该比谁都清楚，和 Sensei 在一起的时间永远都不够。

lines.en: : I’m afraid I just can’t get enough of this guy and those big ole dreamy eyes of his.
lines.zh: ：我怕是这辈子都看不够这个男人，还有他那双又大又梦幻的眼睛。

lines.en: : Watch your step, Uta.
lines.zh: ：说话注意点，Uta。

lines.en: : Right. Wonderful.
lines.zh: ：好。真是太好了。

lines.en: : You can have him all you like after I brief him on what the weekend will entail.
lines.zh: ：等我给他做完这个周末的简报，你想怎么霸占他都行。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree7
: And then I’ll de-brief him, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: ：然后再由我来给他「脱」简报，你懂我意思的。

lines.en: : I do. And not only is it rude but absolutely deconstructive to the actual briefing and-
lines.zh: ：我懂。而且这不仅失礼，更是对正经简报的彻底解构，而且——

lines.en: : Oh. Wait. You meant like that.
lines.zh: ：哦。等等。你是那个意思。

lines.en: : If anyone wants my opinion, I say we jump right to the de-briefing part.
lines.zh: ：要是有人想听我的意见，我说咱们直接跳到「脱」简报那部分。

lines.en: : All in favor, please say aye.
lines.zh: ：赞成的请说「赞成」。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree8
: Aye!
lines.zh: ：赞成！

lines.en: : Really? No one else?
lines.zh: ：真的？没有别人了吗？

lines.en: : I could have sworn at least one of you would have jumped in.
lines.zh: ：我还以为你们里头至少有一个会跳出来的。

lines.en: Especially considering the fact that I have made both first floor residents in the room cum on at least one occasion each.
lines.zh: 尤其是考虑到这屋里的两位一楼住户，我每个人都至少弄射过一次。

lines.en: : May I continue now? Or would you prefer to remain a pervert for a little while longer?
lines.zh: ：我现在能继续了吗？还是你想再当一会儿变态？

lines.en: : I think you already know the answer to that, Makoto.
lines.zh: ：我想你早就知道答案了，Makoto。

lines.en: if dormwarfloor1win == True:
: Then, at the risk of further delaying our first day here, I’d like to take this opportunity to remind you about sleeping arrangements.
lines.zh: ：那么，冒着让第一天继续拖延的风险，我想借这个机会提醒你一下住宿安排。

lines.en: : The Tsukioka family was kind enough to rent out the entirety of the inn for the weekend, so you will have a room to yourself.
lines.zh: ：Tsukioka 家好心把这间旅馆整个周末都包下来了，所以你会有一间自己的房间。

lines.en: : However, as a result of the first annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War, you will be forced to stay with us first floor girls for at least one of two nights.
lines.zh: ：不过，由于第一届超无敌究极宿舍大战的结果，两晚里你至少有一晚会被迫和我们一楼的女生住一起。

lines.en: : Which night would you-
lines.zh: ：你想选哪一晚——

lines.en: : Tonight. The sooner, the better.
lines.zh: ：今晚。越早越好。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree9
: Well...as excited as I am to hear about your...excitement, I’d like to remind you that there may be no foul play whatsoever.
lines.zh: ：嗯……虽然听到你这么……兴奋我很激动，但我想提醒你，这里可能不会发生任何违规行为。

lines.en: : Stupid first floor. There would be plenty of foul play in our room.
lines.zh: ：一楼真蠢。我们房间里的违规行为可多着呢。

lines.en: : Fair is fair, though. I’ll just spend the night playing board games or whatever it is Makoto has planned for me.
lines.zh: ：不过公平归公平。我就通宵玩桌游之类的，随便 Makoto 给我安排了什么。

lines.en: : The sleepover itself isn’t planned. You’re free to do whatever you’d like there.
lines.zh: ：过夜本身没有安排。你在那儿想干什么都行。

lines.en: : I just don’t want you getting ahead of yourself in a room full of girls who like you far more than any student should like their teacher.
lines.zh: ：我只是不想让你在一屋子喜欢你、喜欢得远超学生该喜欢老师的程度的女生面前得意忘形。

lines.en: : Hey, you’re one of those girls.
lines.zh: ：嘿，你也是其中一个。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree10
: E...Even if I am, that doesn’t change the fact that this is an important rule that must be followed at all costs!
lines.zh: ：即……即使我是，也改变不了这是个必须不惜一切代价遵守的重要规则！

lines.en: : Or at least at the risk of any future beach gatherings! I like this tradition and I want it to stay!
lines.zh: ：或者至少要冒着以后再也办不成海滩聚会的危险！我喜欢这个传统，我想把它保住！

lines.en: : Is it really a tradition if it’s only happened once?
lines.zh: ：只发生过一次，也算传统吗？

lines.en: : To me, it is!
lines.zh: ：对我来说，就是！

lines.en: : Now accept your fate and sleep with everyone on the first floor!
lines.zh: ：现在接受你的命运，和一楼的所有人一起睡！

lines.en: : Well, when you put it that way...
lines.zh: ：嗯，你这么一说……

lines.en: : I saw a vending machine near the entrance selling rubbers if you think you’ll wind up needing one or...ten.
lines.zh: ：入口附近有台自动售货机卖保险套，要是你觉得会用到一个或者……十个的话。

lines.en: : I won’t be needing any, Uta. I’m-
lines.zh: ：我不需要，Uta。我正在——

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree11
: Remaining abstinent for the weekend. And hopefully the duration of the[school] year.
lines.zh: ：这个周末保持禁欲。希望整个[school]年都能坚持下去。

lines.en: I’m sure Makoto would be one of the first to crack if I actually had the moral compass to do such a thing.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，要是我真有那个道德罗盘去做这种事，Makoto 会是最先崩溃的人之一。

lines.en: So I’ll do her a favor by revoking said abstinence the second I have the opportunity to.
lines.zh: 所以我打算行行好，一有机会就把这份禁欲给撤销掉。

lines.en: You can thank me later, Makoto.
lines.zh: 以后再谢我吧，Makoto。

lines.en: jump endofsecondbeach3
if dormwarfloor2win == True:
: Then, at the risk of further delaying our first day here, I’d like to take this opportunity to remind you about sleeping arrangements.
lines.zh: ：那么，冒着让第一天继续拖延的风险，我想借这个机会提醒你一下住宿安排。

lines.en: : The Tsukioka family was kind enough to rent out the entirety of the inn for the weekend, so you will have a room to yourself.
lines.zh: ：Tsukioka 家好心把这间旅馆整个周末都包下来了，所以你会有一间自己的房间。

lines.en: : However...as the result of the first annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War ended in favor of the girls on the second floor, you will be obligated to spend at least one night with them.
lines.zh: ：不过……由于第一届超无敌究极宿舍大战的结果是二楼女生获胜，你至少得有一晚跟她们一起过。

lines.en: : Which night would you-
lines.zh: ：你想选哪一晚——

lines.en: : Tonight. The sooner, the better.
lines.zh: ：今晚。越早越好。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree12
: Ooof course.
lines.zh: ：哼，当然了。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Can’t stay away, can ya?
lines.zh: ：嘿嘿~ 离不开我们了吧？

lines.en: : Greetings, Sir. I’d like to take this opportunity to invite you to get up close and personal with your estranged semi-imouto in a futon clearly sized for only one person.
lines.zh: ：您好，先生。我想借这个机会邀请您，和您疏远了的半个妹妹在一张明显只够一个人睡的被褥里亲密无间。

lines.en: : If you close your eyes, you can even pretend I’m my sister. I really don’t care.
lines.zh: ：您要是闭上眼睛，甚至可以假装我是我姐姐。我真的不在乎。

lines.en: : Just kidding. I do care.
lines.zh: ：开玩笑的。我在乎。

lines.en: : Please love me.
lines.zh: ：请爱我吧。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree13
: Chill, girl. The sleepover hasn’t even started yet.
lines.zh: ：冷静点，丫头。过夜还没开始呢。

lines.en: : Sorry. I-
lines.zh: ：抱歉。我——

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree14
: Waaaaaaait a second...
lines.zh: ：等……等一下……

lines.en: : ...What?
: You just wanted to be invited in too, didn’t you?
lines.zh: ：你只是也想被邀请进来，对吧？

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree15
: Wha-
: No! That’s obviously not what I meant!
lines.zh: ：不！我明显不是那个意思！

lines.en: : Okay, Sensei. You can snuggle with Uta and me in my futon. But I get first dibs.
lines.zh: ：好吧，Sensei。你可以和 Uta 还有我一起在我的被褥里依偎。不过我优先。

lines.en: : Noriko!
lines.zh: ：Noriko！

lines.en: : No one is getting dibs on anyone.
lines.zh: ：谁也别想对谁优先。

lines.en: : Even if the second floor is prepared to be a madhouse, I have selected an operative from there who will be ensuring there is no foul play involved.
lines.zh: ：就算二楼准备变成疯人院，我也从那边挑了一个行动人员，负责确保不会发生任何违规行为。

lines.en: : Right. And who is that operative, Makoto?
lines.zh: ：是吗。那这个行动人员是谁，Makoto？

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree16
: Kirin was more than willing to lend a hand in ensuring that the impending sleepover would remain as wholesome as possible.
lines.zh: ：Kirin 非常乐意出手，确保这场即将到来的过夜尽可能的健康纯洁。

lines.en: Oh, Makoto. So smart, yet so dumb.
lines.zh: 哦，Makoto。聪明是真聪明，蠢也是真蠢。

lines.en: jump endofsecondbeach3
if dormwartie == True:
: Then, at the risk of further delaying our first day here, I’d like to take this opportunity to-
lines.zh: ：那么，冒着让第一天继续拖延的风险，我想借这个机会——

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree17
: Wait!
lines.zh: ：等等！

lines.en: : What now? This is honestly getting extremely annoying.
lines.zh: ：又怎么了？说实话这已经烦到极点了。

lines.en: : We’ve still gotta do the coin toss thingy, right? To see where Sensei is spending the night.
lines.zh: ：我们还得抛硬币吧？决定 Sensei 今晚睡哪儿。

lines.en: : Coin toss?
lines.zh: ：抛硬币？

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree18
: It was the only entirely fair way we could come up with to decide the final winner of the dorm war’s grand prize.
lines.zh: ：这是我们唯一能想出来的完全公平的方式，来决定宿舍大战头奖的最终归属。

lines.en: : Unless you’re fine with just spending both nights in your own personal-
lines.zh: ：除非你愿意两晚都待在自己那间专属的——

lines.en: : Hell no. Flip that coin, Makoto. Let’s see what fate has in store for me now.
lines.zh: ：见鬼，不要。抛吧，Makoto。让我看看命运这次给我准备了什么。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree19
: Hopefully it’s a muzzle.
lines.zh: ：希望是个嘴套。

lines.en: scene black
Makoto removes a coin from her pocket and steps aside so there’s no risk of flipping it onto the table and then having either Miku or Io run away with it and buy a soda or something.
lines.zh: Makoto 从口袋里掏出一枚硬币，往旁边站了站，免得把硬币抛到桌上，然后被 Miku 或 Io 抢走去买汽水什么的。

lines.en: That or slyly position the coin onto whichever side favors them...but that would probably require an intense amount of talent in sleight of hand or-
lines.zh: 或者也可以偷偷把硬币摆成对她们有利的那一面……不过那大概需要极高的手法技巧，或者——

lines.en: You know what? Makoto goes to flip a coin.
lines.zh: 算了。Makoto 抛硬币去了。

lines.en: Watch.
lines.zh: 看着。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree20
: So...at long last, we’ll finally be able to settle this.
lines.zh: ：那么……经过这么久，我们终于能解决这个问题了。

lines.en: : The battle to decide which floor is truly the superior one...
lines.zh: ：决定哪一层才是真正优越的那一层的战斗……

lines.en: : I mean, technically the superiority thing ended in a tie. This is just a tiebreaker to see who gets the prize.
lines.zh: ：我是说，严格来讲那个优越性之争是平局。这只是个加赛，决定谁拿到奖品。

lines.en: : Both floors are equally adorable and awesome.
lines.zh: ：两层都同样可爱、同样棒。

lines.en: : Except for floor two, which sucks.
lines.zh: ：除了二楼，二楼烂透了。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree21
: Why are you being so mean all of a sudden?
lines.zh: ：你怎么突然这么刻薄？

lines.en: : Sleep deprivation. I can’t help it.
lines.zh: ：睡眠不足。我控制不住。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree22
: But that doesn’t matter!
lines.zh: ：不过那不重要！

lines.en: : My feelings certainly do matter, Makoto.
lines.zh: ：我的感受当然很重要，Makoto。

lines.en: : But what matters more is deciding the winner!
lines.zh: ：但更重要的是决出赢家！

lines.en: : If the coin lands on heads, you’ll be staying with the first floor.
lines.zh: ：要是硬币正面朝上，你就跟一楼住。

lines.en: : Which means if it lands on tails, you’re gonna be with us!
lines.zh: ：也就是说背面朝上的话，你就跟我们了！

lines.en: : How do you want me to flip it, Sensei? Hard or soft?
lines.zh: ：你想让我怎么抛，Sensei？用力还是轻柔？

lines.en: : Can you ask again but without the “flipping it” part?
lines.zh: ：你能不能重新问一遍，去掉「抛它」那部分？

lines.en: : Fuck you. Hard or soft.
lines.zh: ：去你的。用力还是轻柔。

lines.en: : Ugh. I guess...
lines.zh: ：呃。我想……

lines.en: menu coinflipbeach:
Flip it hard
lines.zh: 用力抛

lines.en: : Flip that coin like you’ve never flipped a coin before.
lines.zh: ：抛那枚硬币，就像你从没抛过硬币一样。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Just...flip it hard.
lines.zh: ：就……用力抛。

lines.en: scene black
Makoto tosses the coin high in the air and everyone in the room watches in anticipation as fate decides where I will spend the night.
lines.zh: Makoto 把硬币高高地抛向空中，屋里的所有人都满怀期待地看着，等命运决定我今晚睡在哪儿。

lines.en: scene beachheads
$ dormwarfloor1win = True
: It’s heads! The first floor wins!
lines.zh: ：是正面！一楼赢！

lines.en: : FUCK!
: Aww man...
lines.zh: ：哎呀……

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree23
: FUCK YEAH! EAT SHIT, SECOND FLOOR!
lines.zh: ：操，太棒了！吃屎吧，二楼！

lines.en: : Jesus, Makoto. Isn’t that taking it a little too far?
lines.zh: ：天啊，Makoto。这是不是有点太过了？

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree24
: Oh my. I’m sooo sorry, Uta.
lines.zh: ：哎呀。我真是太抱歉了，Uta。

lines.en: : You don’t have to apologize, just don’t be that mean next-
lines.zh: ：你不用道歉，下次别这么刻薄就——

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree25
: SORRY FOR KICKING YOUR ASS! HA!
lines.zh: ：抱歉揍了你们的屁股！哈！

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree26
: Ahem...
lines.zh: ：咳哼……

lines.en: : So, it appears that Sensei will be sleeping with the girls of the first floor.
lines.zh: ：那么，看来 Sensei 要和一楼的女生们一起睡了。

lines.en: : Now, onto the next order of business...
lines.zh: ：现在，进入下一项议程……

lines.en: jump endofsecondbeach3
Flip it soft
lines.zh: 轻柔地抛

lines.en: : Just drop it and see what happens.
lines.zh: ：直接让它掉下去，看会怎样。

lines.en: : I’m not going to just drop the coin. It needs to be flipped.
lines.zh: ：我不会直接把硬币丢下去的。它得被抛起来。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: ：为什么？

lines.en: : Because it...
lines.zh: ：因为它……

lines.en: : It does.
lines.zh: ：它就是得抛。

lines.en: : Screw you, I’m flipping it softly.
lines.zh: ：去你的，我就轻柔地抛。

lines.en: scene black
$ dormwarfloor2win = True
Makoto lightly tosses the coin in the air and everyone in the room watches in anticipation as fate decides where I will spend the night.
lines.zh: Makoto 轻轻把硬币抛向空中，屋里的所有人都满怀期待地看着，等命运决定我今晚睡在哪儿。

lines.en: scene beachtails
: Ahh! Tails! We win! We win!
lines.zh: ：啊！背面！我们赢了！我们赢了！

lines.en: : God is real! He has blessed us!
lines.zh: ：上帝是真的！祂保佑了我们！

lines.en: : Uhh...yaaaay...
scene secondbeachthree27
: Heh heh heh...
lines.zh: ：嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : It appears that what fate wants is for Sensei to grow a little closer to all of us who didn’t get a head start.
lines.zh: ：看来命运想要的是，让 Sensei 和我们这些没抢跑的人亲近一点。

lines.en: : I’d like to take this opportunity to thank my mom and dad. If it weren’t for them, I don’t know if I would have ever gotten the courage to stand up here and accept this honor today.
lines.zh: ：我想借这个机会感谢我的爸爸妈妈。如果没有他们，我不知道自己会不会有勇气站在这里，接受今天的这份荣誉。

lines.en: : Oh, please. It was just a coin flip.
lines.zh: ：哦，拜托。就只是抛个硬币而已。

lines.en: : If you really want fate to decide, you’ll do two out of three.
lines.zh: ：你要是真想让命运决定，那就三局两胜。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree28
: Nice try, Makoto. But I ain’t the type to fall for such silly little games.
lines.zh: ：想得美，Makoto。我可不上这种小把戏的当。

lines.en: : Now be a good girl and accept that you really are part of the inferior floor after all.
lines.zh: ：现在乖一点，承认你们确实属于那个更差的楼层吧。

lines.en: : But...but you said-
lines.zh: ：可……可你说过——

lines.en: : Hey, your words. Not mine.
lines.zh: ：嘿，那是你自己说的。不是我。

lines.en: : I was more than willing to do this nicely.
lines.zh: ：我本来是很愿意好聚好散的。

lines.en: : I’ll put our futon in the corner of the room so nobody has to step over us and we can get as close as we want.
lines.zh: ：我会把我们的被褥铺在房间角落，这样谁也不用跨过我们，我们想贴多近就贴多近。

lines.en: : A-Again! There will be no inappropriate conduct of any sorts!
lines.zh: ：又……又来了！绝对不允许有任何不当行为！

lines.en: : It’s only inappropriate if one of us doesn’t consent. Otherwise, it’s totally fine.
lines.zh: ：只有在我们中有一个人不同意的时候才算不当。否则完全没问题。

lines.en: : That is not how[school] trips work, Noriko!
lines.zh: ：[school]旅行不是这么运作的，Noriko！

lines.en: : Yeah yeah yeah. Just get on with the rest of your schedule thingy so we can start plannin’ our night of fun with our teacher.
lines.zh: ：行行行。赶紧把你那堆日程讲完，我们好开始策划和老师一起度过的欢乐之夜。

lines.en: : Ugh! This is ridiculous...
lines.zh: ：呃！这太荒唐了……

lines.en: jump endofsecondbeach3
label endofsecondbeach3:
scene black
Makoto removes a notebook from a bag she’d left near the door and takes her place beside Uta against one of the paper walls of the inn.
lines.zh: Makoto 从她放在门边的包里拿出一本笔记本，挨着 Uta 靠在旅馆的纸墙上站好。

lines.en: I can already feel that I’m going to hate whatever is coming, but I’ll at least try and give her the benefit of the doubt and listen since she’s clearly spent a good amount of time preparing for this.
lines.zh: 我已经感觉到接下来不管是什么我都会讨厌，但至少我愿意先给她一个信任的余地，听一听——毕竟她显然在这上面花了不少时间准备。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree29
: So, since this is a beach trip in the middle of winter, I’ve decided that it would be in everyone’s best interest if we were to completely forego swimsuits as a whole.
lines.zh: ：那么，既然这是隆冬时节的海滩旅行，我决定，为了大家好，我们干脆彻底不穿泳衣。

lines.en: : As in...walk around naked?
lines.zh: ：意思是……光着身子到处走？

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree30
: As in remain in either our casual clothes or our pajamas for the duration of the weekend.
lines.zh: ：意思是整个周末都穿着便服或者睡衣。

lines.en: : This idea sucks.
lines.zh: ：这主意烂透了。

lines.en: I tried to give Makoto the benefit of the doubt and was immediately let down.
lines.zh: 我试着给 Makoto 一个信任的余地，结果立刻就失望了。

lines.en: This is why I can’t trust anyone.
lines.zh: 这就是我不能相信任何人的原因。

lines.en: : This idea, if executed properly, will keep essentially all of us perfectly healthy.
lines.zh: ：这个主意如果执行得当，能让我们基本上所有人都保持完全健康。

lines.en: : If we get sick, we’re unable to come to[school]. And that reflects poorly on not only you, but on me as your classroom assistant and-
lines.zh: ：要是我们病了，就没法来[school]。这不仅对你是负面影响，对我这个班级助理也是，而且——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Next rule, please.
lines.zh: ：行行行。下一条规则，请。

lines.en: : The next rule is that if anyone needs to use the restroom, they should sign out on the sheet I provided or, at the very least, go with a partner so that we do not wind up losing any-
lines.zh: ：下一条规则是，如果有人要上厕所，必须在我提供的表格上登记，或者至少找个同伴一起去，免得我们走丢任何——

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree31
: Makoto. I’m gonna say this as nice as I can.
lines.zh: ：Makoto。我会尽量说得委婉点。

lines.en: : These rules suck.
lines.zh: ：这些规则烂透了。

lines.en: : I...beg your pardon?
lines.zh: ：你……说什么？

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree32
: What happened to the fun Makoto we had during the dorm war?
lines.zh: ：宿舍大战那会儿那个有趣的 Makoto 去哪儿了？

lines.en: : We’re all [teenage]girls. We can’t be lettin’ ourselves get bogged down by...bathroom sign out sheets and curfews.
lines.zh: ：我们都是[teenage]女生。我们不能让自己被什么上厕所登记表、宵禁之类的东西拖垮。

lines.en: : But I didn’t mention curfews...
lines.zh: ：可我还没提到宵禁呢……

lines.en: : You were gettin’ there, weren’t ya?
lines.zh: ：你正要说到那儿了吧？

lines.en: : Yes...
: All I’m sayin’ is just let us be girls for a day or two. And you be a girl yourself.
lines.zh: ：我想说的就是，让我们当一两天女生吧。你自己也当个女生。

lines.en: : Paint your nails. Eat a croissant. You know...girl stuff.
lines.zh: ：涂涂指甲。吃个可颂。你知道的……女生的事。

lines.en: : I...was unaware up to this point that croissants were exclusive to girls.
lines.zh: ：我……在此之前还真不知道可颂是女生专属的。

lines.en: : Damn it. I like croissants, too.
lines.zh: ：该死。我也喜欢可颂。

lines.en: : Just have fun!
lines.zh: ：就好好玩嘛！

lines.en: : If you’re relaxed, we’re all relaxed!
lines.zh: ：你放松了，我们就都放松了！

lines.en: : And if we’re all relaxed, we’ll be able to look back on this trip with smiles on our faces.
lines.zh: ：要是我们都放松了，以后回想这趟旅行时脸上就能带着笑。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree33
: Hah...you’re right.
lines.zh: ：哈……你说得对。

lines.en: : I knew I was going too far with this.
lines.zh: ：我就知道自己做得太过了。

lines.en: : I just figured that if we were going to have a second chaperone this year that it would be good to lay out a few more ground rules and-
lines.zh: ：我只是想着，既然今年会有第二个监护人，那多定几条基本规则也好，而且——

lines.en: : Wait wait wait.
lines.zh: ：等等等等。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree34
: Why why why?
lines.zh: ：怎么怎么怎么？

lines.en: : What do you mean “second chaperone?”
lines.zh: ：什么叫「第二个监护人」？

lines.en: : You’re not counting yourself, are you?
lines.zh: ：你不会是在算你自己吧？

lines.en: : Of course not.
lines.zh: ：当然不是。

lines.en: : The second chaperone is Miss Watabe.
lines.zh: ：第二个监护人是 Watabe 老师。

lines.en: : And from what I understand, her significant other is-
lines.zh: ：据我所知，她的另一半是——

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree35
: GO GO GO GO GO!
lines.zh: ：冲冲冲冲冲！

lines.en: : Geh. Heckin' Christ.
lines.zh: ：呃。该死的主啊。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree36
: Freeze! Yuri police!
lines.zh: ：不许动！百合警察！

lines.en: : Yuri...police?
lines.zh: ：百合……警察？

lines.en: : Word on the street is you punks are harboring a refugee by the name of Wakana Watabe!
lines.zh: ：街上传言说你们这群小混混在窝藏一个叫 Watabe Wakana 的逃犯！

lines.en: : Where is she located?!
lines.zh: ：她在哪儿？！

lines.en: : I don’t know. She likely hasn’t gotten-
lines.zh: ：我不知道。她大概还没——

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree37
: I SAID WHERE IS SHE LOCATED, DAMN IT?!
lines.zh: ：我说了她在哪儿，该死？！

lines.en: : Hey, Nodoka. Thank you for wearing a swimsuit.
lines.zh: ：嘿，Nodoka。谢谢你穿了泳衣。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree38
: Thank you. I am feeling awfully cute today.
lines.zh: ：谢谢。我今天觉得自己可爱得不得了。

lines.en: : Thank you as well, Otoha.
lines.zh: ：也谢谢你，Otoha。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree39
: Well...you know. Beach.
lines.zh: ：嗯……你知道的。海滩嘛。

lines.en: : I kind of didn’t think I’d be wearing this at all with how cold it is, but I am apparently now a member of the yuri police and...this is the uniform or something.
lines.zh: ：这么冷，我其实压根没想过自己会穿这个，但显然我现在成了百合警察的一员，而……这就是制服什么的。

lines.en: : Looks like I’m going to need to search the room.
lines.zh: ：看来我得搜一搜这个房间了。

lines.en: : And also privately pat each one of you down.
lines.zh: ：还要私下把你们每个人都搜身一遍。

lines.en: : Except for Noriko. She’s too eager and it turns me off.
lines.zh: ：Noriko 除外。她太猴急了，让我倒胃口。

lines.en: : And here I was ready to invite you to the futon snugglefest.
lines.zh: ：我还准备邀请你来参加被褥拥抱大会呢。

lines.en: : Otoha. Hold down the living room.
lines.zh: ：Otoha。守住客厅。

lines.en: : I’m starting the search with their leader.
lines.zh: ：我从她们的头儿开始搜。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Right.
lines.zh: ：嗯哼。好。

lines.en: scene black
: Nodoka! How many times do I have to tell you that I am not interested in women?!
lines.zh: ：Nodoka！我要说多少次你才明白，我对女人没兴趣？！

lines.en: : Apparently more because I do not believe you!
lines.zh: ：显然还得再说几次，因为我不信！

lines.en: Nodoka storms over to Makoto and does...Nodoka stuff.
lines.zh: Nodoka 气势汹汹地冲向 Makoto，然后做了些……Nodoka 会做的事。

lines.en: But I use this opportunity to make my way over to Otoha and attempt to counteract the strangeness that has filled the room by talking to the most [[probably] normal person I know.
lines.zh: 但我趁这个机会走到 Otoha 身边，试图通过和我认识的[[probably]最正常的人说说话，来抵消充斥房间的怪异感。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree40

lines.zh: ：那么……

lines.en: : I’ve always liked women in uniform.
lines.zh: ：我一直都很喜欢穿制服的女人。

lines.en: : I’m gonna go ahead and forget you just said that, if that’s cool.
lines.zh: ：我就当没听见你刚才那句话了，可以吧。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. It was worth a shot.
lines.zh: ：抱歉。值得一试嘛。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree41
: I get it. I did say it was my uniform, so I kinda set myself up for that one.
lines.zh: ：我懂。我确实说了那是我的制服，所以也算是我自己送上门的。

lines.en: : I’m glad that we have reached an understanding so quickly.
lines.zh: ：很高兴我们这么快就达成了共识。

lines.en: : Don’t really have a lot of time since I’m gonna get called on to pat somebody down any minute now.
lines.zh: ：时间不多，我随时可能被喊去搜别人的身。

lines.en: : Doubtful. I imagine Nodoka would like to personally conduct her own strip searches of everyone in the room.
lines.zh: ：未必。我猜 Nodoka 会想亲自对屋里的每个人做裸体搜查。

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree42
: Yeah, probably.
lines.zh: ：嗯，大概吧。

lines.en: : That seems like...
lines.zh: ：那感觉像是……

lines.en: : ...a thing she’d...
lines.zh: ：……她会做的……

lines.en: scene secondbeachthree40
: Fuck it. Can you talk?
lines.zh: ：管他呢。你能聊聊吗？

lines.en: : I’m talking right now.
lines.zh: ：我现在就在聊啊。

lines.en: : Privately. Before my...co-worker notices I’m gone.
lines.zh: ：私下聊。趁我的……同事还没发现我不见了。

lines.en: : This is unusual.
lines.zh: ：这可不常见。

lines.en: : It won’t take long. Or at least I hope it won’t take long.
lines.zh: ：不会太久。至少我希望不会太久。

lines.en: : Just...not really sure who else to talk to about this, so you’re gonna have to deal with it for a little while.
lines.zh: ：只是……不太确定这事还能跟谁说，所以你得将就我一会儿。

lines.en: : Or you could just completely ignore me, forget I ever asked this, and I can figure shit out myself.
lines.zh: ：或者你也可以完全无视我，当我没问过，我自己想办法搞定。

lines.en: : No, I’ll come. Just...lead the way, I guess.
lines.zh: ：不，我去。只是……你带路吧。

lines.en: : I have literally never been here before and have no idea where I am going.
lines.zh: ：我可是从来没来过这儿，完全不知道自己在往哪儿走。

lines.en: : Then just walk in a general direction and I’ll...walk behind you?
lines.zh: ：那你就随便挑个方向走，我……跟在你后面？

lines.en: : Or...next to me. Like a normal person.
lines.zh: ：或者……走我旁边。像个正常人一样。

lines.en: : I guess that would be the normal thing to do, yeah.
lines.zh: ：我想那才是正常人会做的事，嗯。

lines.en: : Yup.
: Okay. Gonna do that now.
lines.zh: ：好。那我现在就走了。

lines.en: scene black
